name: Hungry Treefrog 88
author: Shoh2008
description: Dark rounded black button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, starts the a animation (pulsing).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Hungry Treefrog 88</title>
<style>
/* Hungry Treefrog 88 by Shoh2008 — https://uiverse.io/Shoh2008/hungry-treefrog-88 */
button {
  padding: 15px 30px;
  font-size: 18px;
  outline: none;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: 0.5s;
  background: #1e1e1e;
  color: greenyellow;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px #363636, inset 0 0 10px #363636;
}

button:hover {
  animation: a 0.5s 1 linear;
}

@keyframes a {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0.7, 1.3);
  }

  25% {
    transform: scale(1.3, 0.7);
  }

  50% {
    transform: scale(0.7, 1.3);
  }

  75% {
    transform: scale(1.3, 0.7);
  }

  100% {
    transform: scale(1, 1);
  }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
